method: Visual inspection of 53 full PDF pages, including complete figures, shared stems, options and continuations; source bytes read from local archive or Git HEAD and SHA256 compared with existing crop metadata.

source_evidence.notes: Printed Q13 begins at bottom of p7 and finishes top-left p8: sort n numbers with k distinct numbers, k not known a priori, give optimal pseudocode and time analysis. No figure/options. Both pages inspected.

Printed Q13 begins at bottom of p7 and finishes top-left p8: sort n numbers with k distinct numbers, k not known a priori, give optimal pseudocode and time analysis. No figure/options. Both pages inspected.
Printed 1.4 on p1 gives four FORTRAN 77 statements DO 13 I = 1; A = DIM ***7; READ = 15.0; GO TO 3 = 10. Shared section instructions permit multiple correct choices. Complete with no figure.

Printed 22 p3 asks false statement among optimal-BST dynamic programming, BFS unable to find connected components, prefix/postfix tree nonuniqueness, and DFS connected components. All four options visible, no diagram.
Printed 3.2 p4: true/false with one-line explanation that expanding-opcode formats are commonly employed in RISC machines. Complete standalone statement, no diagram.

Printed 49(a)/(b) p7: six statements read n; i:=1; if i>n goto next; a(i):=i+1; i:=i+1; next:write a(i). Part a asks precedence graph and part b conversion to concurrent program using parbegin-parend only. No backward jump printed. Shared code fully visible; no supplied precedence diagram.
Printed 58(b) bottom-right p6 asks lexical errors in Pascal statement if A > 1, then B = 2.5A else read(C);. Complete line, no figure.
Printed 19 p3 asks definition of a critical-section program segment; options concern bounded runtime, avoiding deadlocks, accessing shared resources, enclosure by P/V. Complete no figure.

Printed 68 begins bottom-right p9 and continues top-left p10. Grammar assign-stmt -> LHS := E; E -> E+T | T; T -> T*V | V; V -> id | (E); LHS -> id. Requests syntax-directed scheme producing postfix type-specific +,*,assignment tokens for real/integer data; give-type and give-name supplied. No figure. Both pages inspected.

Printed 70(a) p10 asks equivalence partition for complete eight-state Mealy table shared with b. Rows for inputs 0/1: A=B,1/H,1; B=F,1/D,1; C=D,0/E,1; D=C,0/F,1; E=D,1/C,1; F=C,1/C,1; G=C,1/D,1; H=C,0/A,1. No initial state supplied. Table and subparts fully visible.
Printed 70(b) p10 uses exact same complete table as 70(a); asks minimal-machine state table and explicitly names merged states by concatenated member names (XY example). No initial state supplied.

Printed 76(a) p12 supplies EMP(eno,name,age), PROJ(pno,name), INVOLVED(eno,pno), key underlines and relation descriptions. SQL select eno from EMP,INVOLVED where EMP.eno=INVOLVED.eno and INVOLVED.pno=3. Requests relational-algebra equivalent from listed operators. No diagram or continuation. Unqualified SELECT eno retained.

Printed 43 p6 has three complete C functions across columns: local x returned by address; uninitialized pointer dereferenced then returned; malloc(sizeof(int)) pointer written and returned. Four combinations of problematic functions supplied. No missing code continuation.
Printed 46 starts bottom-right p5 with all three multiprogramming criteria; options continue top-left p6: a only; a,b; a,c; a,b,c. Both pages visually inspected. No figure.
Printed 46 starts bottom-right p5 with all three multiprogramming criteria; options continue top-left p6: a only; a,b; a,c; a,b,c. Both pages visually inspected. No figure.
Printed 9 bottom-right p1 asks signal active while INTR-requesting device puts CALL instruction on data bus. Options active-low INTA, HOLD, READY, none. Complete no diagram.

Printed 44 p6: one input/two output synchronous sequential machine counts 0s and 1s in first k bits. Output 00 until count difference reaches +2 or -2, then latches forever to 10 or 01. Asks minimum transition-graph state count; choices 5,6,7,8. Complete no supplied graph.
Printed 4 p1 inserts 10,1,3,5,15,12,16 into empty BST in given order, asks maximum leaf distance from root. Options span column break on same full page (2,3,4,6). No tree supplied.

Printed 49 p7: inode has ten direct and one each single/double/triple indirect pointers; 1 Kbyte blocks, 32-bit block addresses, 48-bit integers; maximum file size options 2^24,2^32,2^34,2^48 span column break on same page. No figure.

Printed 40 p5 defines current four-bit Gray word for n and next word for n+1 modulo16. Three minterm options p5, fourth at top-left p6. Both pages inspected; option A small glyph remains fuzzy (existing 3/5 reproduction caveat should remain), others sufficient to establish next-state ON-set task. No figure.

Printed 62 p9 supplies 32-bit virtual addresses, 4KB pages, 128-entry four-way set-associative TLB; asks minimum tag size, choices 11,13,15,20. Complete no diagram.

Printed 8 starts bottom-right p1: free-running 50% duty clock, f changes only on negative edge; choose clocked D circuit delaying phase by 180 degrees. A shown p1; B,C,D continue top-left p2. Visually checked all four two-stage diagrams: A inverted f/inverted first clock/complemented first Q/normal second clock; B inverted f/normal first clock/Q/inverted second clock; C f/normal first clock/Q/inverted second clock; D f/inverted first clock/complemented first Q/normal second clock. All figures present.

Visually checked all four two-stage diagrams: A inverted f/inverted first clock/complemented first Q/normal second clock; B inverted f/normal first clock/Q/inverted second clock; C f/normal first clock/Q/inverted second clock; D f/inverted first clock/complemented first Q/normal second clock. All figures present.

Two printed flag-based critical-section loops, both flags initially false; each raises its own flag then spins on the other. All four options checked. Requires interleaving analysis of mutual exclusion/deadlock, not semaphore counts or a state-minimization procedure.

Full labeled process-state diagram checked: A Start→Ready, B Ready→Running, C Running→Ready, D Running→Terminated, E Blocked→Ready, F Running→Blocked. Always-ready uniprocessor premise and four statements/options present. Must distinguish dispatch from admission and identify preemption and independent I/O completion.

Printed Q12: student registration, national UID, joint/multiple bank accounts, name and hostel room; all four key/superkey statements checked. Semantic uniqueness judgment, not attribute closure from supplied FDs.
Printed Q19 asks necessary and sufficient machine power for lexical analysis; four alternatives FSA, DPDA, NPDA, Turing machine. No automaton to minimize or construct.

Printed Q35: circular queue capacity n−1 in n slots; FRONT=REAR=0, insertion REAR, deletion FRONT. All four full/empty predicate pairs checked. Derive wraparound sentinel conditions rather than just queue operation complexity.

Printed Q65: erection cost Rs13200, daily wages increase 1/5 and working hours decrease 1/24; four numeric costs checked. Inverse work-rate scaling as well as price scaling; not the same procedure as successive fare discounts.

Printed Q22 includes both foreign-key versus SQL assertion claim and CREATE TABLE S with a single-column reference to composite primary key (a,b). All truth-combination options checked; constraint expressibility and reference validity, not FD closure.
Round-trip discount 10 percent plus 5 percent for groups >=4; Rs100 one-way, five tourists, numeric answer. Successive fare discounts; no work-rate change.

Dengue doubling argument and all four possible explanations checked: imported cases, reporting efficiency, new diagnostic test, malaria increase. Task is choosing the explanation that does not undermine the mosquito-control conclusion, not finite-state reasoning.

Full text specifies positive-edge D and JK flip-flops on common free-running clock; D.Q drives J and K, JK.Q drives D; initial D=1, JK=0; nonzero delays; toggle/hold rules explicit. All four output-sequence alternatives include initial value. Simultaneously update both bits from old state and trace JK output.

Printed Q10 asks asymptotic bounds for efficient array ENQUEUE and DEQUEUE; four O/Omega combinations checked. Does not specify the n−1 sentinel representation or ask wraparound predicates, so retain apart from 2012 Q45.

Full literary/ideology passage and culture/seemingly/urgent/political alternatives inspected. Requires identifying qualifying word expressing author attitude, distinct from extracting a literal fact or causal inference.

Printed Q10 states resident memory time M, total faulting-access time D, observed mean X; four rational expressions checked. Solve two-case expectation for fault probability; not cache-tag geometry or virtual-address state legality.

Printed Q14 asks false B+ tree structural claim; options height balance, nonleaf data-record pointers, sorted keys and linked leaves checked. Concept recognition, not search-path tracing or tree construction.

Printed Q53 complete C loop checked: a={2,4,6,8,10}, b=a+4, sum +=(*b-i)-*(b-i) for i=0..4, prints integer. Requires distinguishing value arithmetic from pointer offset in an array, not string termination or dangling-pointer diagnosis.
Full High Court begging passage and four inferences checked. Causal paraphrase of social-security failure, not the author-attitude word selection in 2017 or literal object description in 2025.

Printed Q12 explicitly says preemptive scheduling. Four directed transition claims Running→Ready, Ready→Running, Blocked→Running, Blocked→Ready and all answer combinations checked. Apply same process-state adjacency and dispatch/awakening distinctions as 2009.

All four virtual-memory claims inspected: parallel TLB lookup, TLB-hit/cache-miss residency, inverted-page-table uniform access, hashed-page collision access times. Compound question needs inverted/hashed-table reasoning beyond 2026 Q54 hit/miss legality; do not fold on one shared option.

All four 2PL claims checked: serializability, lock/release around each operation, no acquisition after first release, possible deadlock. Conceptual growth/shrink protocol rules; no specific transaction schedule to simulate.
All four IPv4 fragmentation/reassembly claims inspected. Router/source roles and destination-only reassembly; option B omits DF qualification. No fragment-size arithmetic or automaton reasoning.

All four attribute-grammar claims checked on full p20: side effects, L-attributed depth-first evaluation, synthesized bottom-up evaluation, L-attributed LR(1) bottom-up generality. Conceptual evaluation-order classification rather than constructing typed postfix translation.

Entire fX char-pointer function and four invocation/compilation claims inspected: scan b until NUL and return b−a. Literal/array/pointer cases preserve printed typographic quotes; not undefined lifetime diagnosis or numeric pointer-loop tracing.
Timeout with congestion window 12 MSS, next two RTTs fully acknowledged, asks window during third RTT. No diagram/options. Slow-start timeout trace, not TCP connection state/closing claims.

Complete eight-state Mealy table inspected, next/output for X=0,1: A F/B 0/0; B D/C 0/0; C F/E 0/0; D G/A 1/0; E D/C 0/0; F F/B 1/1; G G/H 0/1; H G/A 1/0. Integer minimum-state count requested. Partition by output pair and refine by successor equivalence; no initial-state restriction printed.
Complete Chesterton pocket passage and four alternatives inspected. Correctly supported literal pocket-knife/sword description differs from author attitude, causal inference, or conditional logic.

Full four-D-flip-flop circuit inspected: Q0→D1, Q1→D2, Q2→D3, complemented Q3→D0; shared rising-edge clock. Arbitrary initial state, asks distinct states before return. Derive simultaneous next-state recurrence and follow orbit; preserve initial-state counting ambiguity rather than changing source.
All TCP connection claims checked: two-way establishment, server forbidden to close first, half-duplex, simultaneous close. Connection lifecycle concepts, not congestion-window evolution.

All four deadlock claims checked: Banker prevention, hold-and-wait prohibition, assignment edge direction, safe-state completion guarantee. Mixed conceptual statements, not a concrete allocation safety sequence or semaphore schedule.

Teacher present implies every student stands silently; all four alternatives inspected including converse and contrapositive. Propositional entailment, distinct from passage-specific literary inference.

Physically addressed cache and TLB explicitly given; evicting main-memory page invalidates its cache blocks. All four TLB/page-table/cache hit-miss sequences checked. Find impossible residency combinations; 2022 Q38 additionally requires hashed/inverted-table facts, so retain separately.

Full javelin six-round premises and four round choices checked, including no medal-winning throws in first two rounds, sixth-round fouls, Vesely second after four and never improves, Vadlejch best fourth-round throw. Constraint elimination over rounds, not generic automaton or passage literal retrieval.

Exclude: mixed algorithm-properties identification, not a BFS-order trace or BST construction procedure.
Exclude: architecture convention classification rather than encoding bit-count calculation.
Exclude: asks fork/join expressibility under conditional control, not semaphore-edge placement or token tracing. Do not silently invent a loop.
Exclude: Pascal lexical/syntactic error identification, not FORTRAN fixed-form name legality or syntax-directed translation.
Exclude: conceptual definition, not synchronization algorithm simulation.
Exclude: attributed typed postfix translator construction; cannot group with lexical error checks or generic postfix output tracing without reviewing a concrete comparable source.
Exclude: join/select/project SQL translation, not key closure or normal-form classification.
Exclude: pointer lifetime/initialization safety classification, not parameter-passing output trace.
Exclude: defining multiprogramming from features, not quantitative CPU-scheduling simulation.
Exclude: interrupt handshake protocol fact, not clocked circuit or processor timing calculation.

Exclude from Mealy-table pair: requires constructing a sufficient history/count-difference model with absorbing outcomes, rather than refining a given transition/output table. Same FSM topic alone insufficient.
Exclude: construct BST then measure height, not ancestor-bound feasibility of a supplied search-probe sequence.
Exclude: hierarchical pointer fanout/capacity sum, not page-table indexing or cache tag partition. Preserve exact-total versus power-of-two-choice caveat.
Exclude: enumerate Gray-code cyclic next-bit truth table, not automaton minimization or negative two-complement encoding.

Keep excluded under current cache-address-field-geometry scope, which explicitly excludes page tables/TLBs. Mathematically shares offset/set/tag subtraction and is a plausible future scope broadening, but do not silently override that reviewed boundary.
Exclude: two-phase storage polarity/clock-delay reasoning, not state-table minimization; source storage interpretation ambiguity remains.

caveats: Grouping review is not transcription, solution, or official-key verification.
Early sources are third-party reproductions; existing missing-XObject rendering warnings and source wording caveats are retained. Every accepted group has complete inspected source content.
CS-2006-Q40 option A retains pre-existing fuzzy 3/5 minterm reproduction ambiguity; excluded independently because its Gray next-bit ON-set task does not fit accepted patterns.
No blanket classification as lexical noise: process-state, Mealy, and flip-flop simulation pairs were accepted; compound and different-procedure tasks remain separately visible.
Source-review coverage is finite candidate coverage, not exhaustive semantic equivalence discovery over every possible pair.
